title: e2e harness scenario
description: One scenario of the e2e harness (chant#4587): a repo tree, the pull request steps the driver takes in order, and the outcomes each step must show, read from chant's own reports and run ledger. A scenario proves one claim, with a plain run that must pass and a BREAK arm that must be caught. Version 1: a field is only ever added within contract 1, and a new field is optional.

id.description: The scenario's id, such as tg-estate-overlap. Rows cite it.

product.description: The product that drives it: terragucci, plywood, sql-yodeler, or chant for its own demo.

claim.description: The claim id the scenario records a row for.

tree.description: The repo the forge serves: a base tree, and the overlays the steps copy over it. Paths are relative to the scenario file.

env.description: The chant environment the pipeline runs (--env), which the ledger records runs under. Default local.

reportUrl.description: The pipeline's --report-url, where pr-plan.json and pr-apply.json land.

limits.description: Seconds each kind of step may take, over the harness's defaults.

break.description: The BREAK arm: the same steps with the claim's subject broken. The run must be caught, meaning one of the outcomes does not hold. env carries BREAK=1 to the pipeline; an overlay may stand in for or add to it.

overlay.description: An overlay copied over every pull request of the break run, after the step's own.

note.description: What the break changes, in a sentence.

pull.description: The id of the open or await-pull step whose pull request this is.

branch.description: The exact head branch of the pull request a product opens. Both runs wait for this same branch: the BREAK run does not add -break to it.

title.description: Text the pull request's title must hold, when given.

pull.description: The id of the open or await-pull step whose pull request the comment goes on.

merge.description: The id of the merge step whose commit the apply runs on.

match.description: Part of the job container's name; the newest running job when absent.

outcome.description: One thing a step must show. report reads the step's pr-plan.json or pr-apply.json; ledger reads the run records the scenario added; gated reads the gated requests the scenario added; comment, issue and pull read the forge; exit is an out-of-band command's exit code.

only.description: components names every component the report has.

gated.description: Gated requests of op on the ledger, asked since the run started. A request is gated until a finished line names it, then ok when it applied and failed when it did not.

comment.description: Text one of the step's pull request comments holds.

pull.description: The step's pull request: its title holds title, it changes every path in files, and with only it changes no other path.

only.description: files names every path the pull request changes.
